title: Asset Quota Blocked
description: This event occurs when an quota is blocked.

quota_block_id.title: Asset block ID
quota_block_id.description: Unique asset block identifier. Generated by Pismo platform.

asset_id.title: Asset ID
asset_id.description: Unique asset identifier defined by client. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It can be used to make redemptions and cancellations.

quota_id.title: Asset Quota ID
quota_id.description: Unique asset identifier defined by client. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Cetip code of registrator of asset. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It needs to be in every API call. An organization can have multiple issuer IDs.

status.title: Asset status
status.description: Whether quota is blocked or unblocked

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Reason quota was blocked or unblocked.

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: External identifier for operation. field provided by customer in quota block operation.

units.title: Units
units.description: Number of units blocked or unblocked

document_number.title: Document Number
document_number.description: Document number linked to the quota

created_at.title: Created date
created_at.description: Creation date of quota block operation on Pismo platform
